validation.notes: All three listed modules were repaired with one terminal-state guard each, keeping existing APIs: (1) packages/agent/src/harness/execution/effect-gate.ts - beginAbort now returns unless the gate is still 'open', so a 'closed' gate keeps throwing its original terminal error from admit(), keeps signal.reason as the terminal error, and can no longer be reopened; beginAbort on an already 'aborting' gate still preserves the first cancellation promise. (2) packages/agent/src/harness/execution/tools.ts - executeToolCall's finally now sets acceptingUpdates = false instead of true, sealing the live update callback at settlement, which also prevents post-completion progress.write/checkpoint writes because the drive only checkpoints updates the executor forwards. (3) packages/agent/src/harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts - recoverToolInvocation only takes the safe-replay path when !cancelled; a cancelled recovery skips clearReplayCheckpoint and performToolInvocation and falls through to readCheckpoint + publishToolOutcome(interruptedOutcome), i.e. no clear, no invoke, no new checkpoint, exactly one published interrupted outcome with durable checkpoint content/details preserved. Non-cancelled safe/safe recovery still clears, uses persisted arguments, invokes once, preserves details/usage and publishes once. The regression script loads the real modules through .prale-eval/subject.mjs (only checkpoint store, progress transport and hook delivery faked), uses uncaught node:assert/strict assertions and promise-driven ordering, and covers: cancelled recovery fence end-to-end; unchanged non-cancelled recovery; executor late-update seal directly on the execution module; end-to-end absence of tool_update and checkpoint after completion; gate terminal-state fencing (close then beginAbort, plus signalAbort not replacing the reason); unchanged open-gate AbortRequested semantics; and a closed gate refusing a fresh recovery effect with its terminal error. Mutation check performed in place: reverting runtime/drive/tools.ts alone fails with 'cancelled recovery must not cross the external effect boundary', reverting execution/tools.ts alone fails with 'updates emitted after completion are dropped by the executor seal', reverting execution/effect-gate.ts alone fails with 'a closed gate keeps rejecting with its terminal error' - each an assertion failure, not a crash, import error or timeout; the repaired tree passes. Limitation: the repository vitest suites under packages/agent/test/harness were not run because the workspace has no installed node_modules and dependency installation was out of scope. No temporary fixtures are created by the script, so nothing was left behind; the only added files are under .prale-eval/.
